divergences.old: sonar issue list, project list and hotspot list --all paging until the total or an empty page, with no limit on the number of pages
divergences.toil: The same stop rule, plus a bound: after 1,000 pages (500,000 items) the command fails with HTTP, naming what was being paged, and fix text to narrow the request
divergences.why: A server that ignores the page parameter would otherwise be asked for the same page forever. No real SonarQube result reaches the bound: issues/search stops at 10,000 results.
